category_edits.rationale: Reduce the feed-forward expansion from 4× to 2× hidden width across all four category models to test whether lower capacity reduces overfitting on short histories. Preserve bidirectional attention, two blocks, two heads, pre-norm residuals, final LayerNorm, embeddings, masking, readout, loss and optimizer. The embedded predictor imports this same model class, so checkpoint shapes remain consistent.

response.change_summary: Narrow BERT4Rec feed-forward layers from 4× to 2× hidden width, retaining one independently trained model per category and compatible predictor construction.
